blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) has narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Of all places, the places most beloved to Allah are the masjids, and the most hated are the marketplaces.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: اَلْمَسَاجِدُ بُيُوتُ اللهِ فِي اْلاَرْضِ تُضِيءُ لأَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ كَمَا تُضِيءُ نُجُومُ السَّمَاءِ لأَهْلِ اْلاَرْضِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير ورجاله موثقون مجمع الزوائد:٢ /١١٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “The masjids are the houses of Allah on earth. Just as the stars shine for those on earth, the masjids shine for those in the heavens.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ﵁ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ بَنَي مَسْجِدًا يُذْكَرُ فِيهِ اسْمُ اللهِ بَنَي اللهُ لَهُ بَيْتاً فِي الْجَنَّةِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Umar ibn Khattab (RA) narrates, “I heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “Whoever builds a masjid in which Allah is remembered, Allah builds a palace for him in Jannah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ غَدَا إِلَي الْمَسْجِدِ وَرَاحَ أَعَدَّ اللهُ لَهُ نُزُلَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ كُلَّمَا غَدَا أَوْ رَاحَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب فضل من غدا الي المسجد ...رقم:٦٦٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever goes to the masjid morning and evening, Allah arranges hospitality for him in Jannah. As many times as he goes to the masjid, whether morning or evening, that many times He arranges hospitality for him.”
